title: 雪谷回响

selectedMaster.selection: 人工首检：左上单一天使、两翼和一号角清晰；右下五人和一犬可逐一辨认，完整雪谷地坪与足迹可见；未做透明、细部或倾斜验收。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1024×1536 portrait master artwork for a layered interactive tarot holographic card, Judgement, theme title “雪谷回响”.
Primary request: exactly one translucent starry angel with exactly two clear wings and exactly one trumpet in the upper-left, intact dark transparent wing detail. Exactly five human figures stand safely in the lower-right on one broad continuous snow-valley foreground ground with visible footprints; exactly one dog lower/front, unobscured. Dawn opens a mountain pass in the right rear. All five people and dog contact the same stable snow ground, no floating people.
Composition: vertical 2:3, angel left-upper, figures right-lower in depth layers, dog lower, sunrise mountain pass right rear. Palette snow white, blue-violet, gold. Detailed premium painterly fantasy tarot. Constraints: exactly 1 angel, 2 wings, 1 trumpet, 5 people, 1 dog; no extras, duplicate limbs, cropped feet, text/border/watermark/checkerboard/holographic effect. Keep wing translucency but do not lose dark wing structures.
generationRuns.conclusion: selected as master candidate; opaque RGB only, not a transparent layer or user-approved art

supportGeometry: complete snowy foreground platform and footprints

lineart.algorithm: luminance Sobel edge pass constrained to alpha >245

implementedAnimations: RuiC viewer auto card motion; angel group, five people, dog and support platform stay fixed within their image plane

assets.conclusion: all five layers share 1024×1536; required RGBA layers contain true transparency and visible pixels

manualVisual.conclusion: no green fringe, duplicate angel/figures, detached dog or failed snowy support platform observed; 320px remains legible

productionDetail.composition: 天使左上，五人右下分层站立，犬低处，山口右后
productionDetail.supportGeometry: 整片雪谷前地坪与足迹保留
productionDetail.connectedGroup: 天使、双翼与号角一组保留软透明；五人与犬在地面稳定组，若不能可靠多主体分层先同一主层；本主题支撑归属：整片雪谷前地坪与足迹保留
productionDetail.foilMask: 号角边、羽翼内部稀疏线与地面衣缘
productionDetail.specificQA: 地面恰好五人一犬；高空一天使两翼一号角；半透明暗部不能被亮度抠图删除
productionDetail.samplePrinciple: 借鉴五样本的完整承接、真实透明、主题材质和极端倾斜复核，不按槽位强行套题材。
productionDetail.motion: 仅少量前景微光呼吸；主体、核心符号和承重结构不自动相对运动。
productionDetail.backgroundOwnership: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。
